title: PM: No RCI to review govt response to recent flood disaster | The Star
text:
PM: No RCI to review govt response to recent flood disaster | The Star
KUALA LUMPUR: The Government does not intend to set up a Royal Commission of Inquiry (RCI) to review its weaknesses and shortcomings in dealing with the recent flood disaster, Prime Minister Datuk Seri Najib Tun Razak (pic) said Monday.
Responding to Datuk Seri Azalina Othman (BN-Pengerang), Najib said setting up an RCI was not a necessity as there were already ongoing efforts by the Government to mitigate the floods.
